title: superclaude starts the ground loop windowless on Windows
intention: On Windows, superclaude's fallback spawn of the ground loop runs it under the venv pythonw.exe, so the loop owns no console and nothing appears on the desktop.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 on akienlivingroom, the media box. Akien: "something keeps popping up while were trying to watch videos. whatevr it is, make it stop". The live loop was `python3 -m cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop` (pids 16556 and 10972) with a visible console; after CC stopped it the pop-ups stopped. The spawner is cairn/devices/cc/superclaude:683, `_sc_spawn_detached "$_sc_loop_log" python3 -m ...ground_loop`: DETACHED_PROCESS|CREATE_NO_WINDOW through python3, the pattern windowless_spawn.background_pythonw's docstring measured on akiendell 2026-11-13 to still own a conhost. The shim's fallback (cairn/tools/base/shim.py:237) and ground_loop/cli.py:123 already use background_pythonw(); superclaude is the one spawner that does not. Fields drafted by akienlivingroom_cc_0, 2026-11-17.
traces_to: CP4 (the box serves him: it is his media box); one spawner spelling (cairn/tools/windowless_spawn).
how: On Windows, superclaude spawns the loop through the interpreter background_pythonw() resolves (the venv pythonw.exe beside the cairn venv's python): call the tool from the heredoc, or resolve the path the way the tool does. The Linux setsid branch is untouched.

clauses.claim: on Windows the process tree superclaude's fallback spawns holds no conhost.exe and no python.exe, only pythonw.exe
the spawned loop still claims the singleton and its log lands in $_sc_loop_log
the Linux setsid branch is byte-identical

decisions.text: D1: the Windows branch of the ground-loop fallback spawns through the interpreter background_pythonw() resolves; the setsid branch is unchanged.
D2: the proof reads the spawn's argv on Windows (and on a Windows box the live tree), one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: a console window for `python3 -m ...ground_loop` (pids 16556/10972) during video playback; no pop-ups after the stop
measured.how: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process command lines on akienlivingroom, then Stop-Process
